Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the year of the Bay of Pigs invasion, incorrectly stating it as "1960" instead of the correct and corroborated date of "April 1961," which had been explicitly provided by CANF and other reputable sources, including the BBC article and Wikipedia. The error occurred because the Planner did not effectively synthesize the information gathered by the WebSurfer up to that point and prematurely concluded the year, despite clear evidence to the contrary. This represents an analytical error where previously validated data was ignored.
